mcq.passage: Summer Camp Schedule LAZY MONDAY Watch a movie, play in the yard, play with blocks, color, or read. Just do something easy and relax. TAKE A TRIP TUESDAY Visit a museum. Take a trip to the zoo. Walk to the park. Just go. WHAT’S COOKING WEDNESDAY Cook something together. Let’s have fun in the kitchen. TRY A CRAFT THURSDAY Try a new fun craft idea. Make play-dough. Finger paint. The options are endless. FUN FRIDAY Do something fun!
